records.text: Citing an unnamed source, Owens said Erika Kirk was in DC “right now,” then revised this to yesterday or “maybe” the day before, adding that she needed to remember. The source and exact day are unverified.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I mean, she's in D.C. right now, by the way. Source, um, on that, which they're going to gaslight me on. Or at least she was yesterday. Maybe it was the day before, I have to remember. Um, but, and it seems to be that when she's in D.C., they, uh, Department of War attacks against me start doubling. I think it's got to pick a better narrative. But I feel like if I was sitting in the room trying to help them cover something, I would have been like, I don't know, maybe go with drug dealer.
